boundary_probes.note: At the eutectoid temperature the alpha/(alpha+gamma) boundary is the maximum solubility of C in ferrite and the (alpha+gamma)/(gamma+Fe3C) boundary is the eutectoid composition.
At the eutectic temperature the gamma/(gamma+L) boundary is the maximum solubility of C in austenite and the (gamma+L)/(L+Fe3C) boundary is the eutectic composition.
At the peritectic temperature the delta/(delta+L) boundary is the maximum solubility of C in delta ferrite and the (delta+L)/L boundary is the peritectic liquid composition.
